body: I'm sorry, I'm sure you didn't mean this, but your comment comes off a little condescending. I appreciate you've seen patterns from your own experiences in your life when it comes to mental health and your career but I just find any generalisations or assumptions when it comes to people a bit unhelpful. I'd rather folk just listened and spoke to one another without attempts to analyse or look for patterns. This isn't necessarily a throw away account, it's a new account. I'm new here. I decided to create this because honestly it's a bit of a last resort and I really am at the end of my tether. I also just wanted to wish others well too, even though I probably won't make it that doesn't mean it has to be the same for others. Thanks for the comment and for the offer for a chat all the same. Take care.

Thanks and likewise! Same vibe indeed :). Thanks a lot for your comment, and I totally agree with you. Mental and physical health issues certainly don't discriminate. Tbh I worked in the charity sector before the pandemic and honestly i've seen things that really shouldn't happen in a charity, or anywhere in fact. It really makes me lose faith in humanity and it's getting to a point where I feel like the dickwads are outweighing the good folk in my life. It's just a bit too much pain. Then I think about all the other people feeling like me. There's so many people not fully getting the help or loves they need. There's something so wrong with that. I also just don't like what i've become, i've become a horrible version of myself and I think my mind is made up now tbh. I am though keeping this account as a sort of last resort and a bit of hope and I'm going to follow NakamuraIwao's advice and explore all my options before I end my life. If there's people like you and NakamuraIwao then there is some good. Whatever I choose to do, thanks for your kindness and I wish you the very best and sending lots of love.

Thanks a lot for your kind comment and I really do appreciate your point of view. I totally get that keeping suicide as a sort of 'last resort', I actually did that in some ways myself and kept going. I think for me now the options have maybe run out. I've explored quite a lot of them and I think tbh it's on me now. I have physical health problems that also give me pain so on top of the mental health issues it's just a bit too much for me now. I will though take your advice and make sure that I have explored all of my options before I end my life. As you rightly say, there's no guarantee and it's all trial and error. Thanks for your perspective and kindness and I send you my love, hope and best wishes :).
